events.scope: 1988 Tombstone/Robbie history, reignited in Amazing Spider-Man (2018) #63 (2021)
events.observation: Marvel identifies a longstanding personal feud between Tombstone and Robbie, reactivated by their children dating.
Tombstone is identified as Janice father and is to walk her down the aisle.
Janice and Randy are dating in #63 and plan a wedding in #31.
Robbie is explicitly identified as Randy father when the relationship with Janice becomes known.
Peter and Randy share housing; Peter is selected as best man for Randy and Janice planned wedding.
Tombstone plots a public killing of Spider-Man, kidnaps Peter Parker as leverage, and fights Spider-Man.
Boomerang is Peter/Spider-Man roommate; Spider-Man attempts to prevent Kingpin from killing him.
Mayor Fisk seeks the Lifeline Tablet and is prepared to kill Boomerang to obtain it.

events.scope: Amazing Spider-Man (1963) #68-75 (1969); exact abduction issue unverified
events.observation: Marvel-hosted Silvermane biography says he abducts Connors to prepare the Lifeline Tablet formula; the official collection places both in the saga.

events.scope: Spectacular Spider-Man (1976), early 1980s crime-war era; exact issue pending
events.observation: Marvel-hosted Silvermane biography says Fisk reanimates Silvermane and controls him using a painful collar.
Cloak and Dagger attempt to kill Silvermane; Spider-Man intervenes to stop them.
Dagger joins Cloak in an attempt to kill Silvermane; Spider-Man tries to stop them.
Tandy and Tyrone resume crimefighting together despite having been separated and dating other people; Marvel identifies unresolved mutual feelings.
Madame Masque overpowers Elektra in the campaign to control New York; Elektra has a blade at her throat.
Richard Fisk, identified as Kingpin son, plots to kill his abusive father; Vanessa attempts to stop him.
With Tombstone absent, Janice steps into leadership and seeks the top position in New York crime.
Marvel guide recounts Dagger leaving Cloak after he attacks churchgoers; the 2018 collection describes their reunion.

claims.documented_fact: The publisher calls their history an old enmity renewed in 2021.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: Feud is historically established, but exact 1988 originating panels were not reviewed.

claims.documented_fact: Marvel describes the conflict as a feud between both fathers.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: Do not assign identical motives to both men.

claims.documented_fact: Tombstone is Janice father and participates in her wedding plans.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: Fatherhood is not proof he endorses all her criminal decisions.

claims.documented_fact: Janice dates Randy and plans to marry him.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: The issue preview does not establish that the marriage was completed.

claims.documented_fact: Randy dates Janice and plans their wedding.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: No permanent post-wedding status inferred.

claims.documented_fact: Robbie is Randy father.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: No specific paternal approval or disapproval is asserted beyond the described family feud.

claims.documented_fact: Peter is Randy roommate and chosen best man.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: The best-man role supports personal friendship; depth and durability not quantified.

claims.documented_fact: Tombstone threatens Spider-Man and kidnaps Peter Parker to reach him.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: The synopsis does not establish Tombstone knows Spider-Man is Peter.

claims.documented_fact: Spider-Man directly fights Tombstone in the 2024 finale.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: An encounter-specific fight is not a permanent personal hatred claim.

claims.documented_fact: Spider-Man attempts to stop Kingpin from killing his roommate Boomerang.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: Protective act does not establish full trust in a criminal roommate.

claims.documented_fact: Fisk is prepared to kill Boomerang for the Lifeline Tablet.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: Threat does not establish a completed killing.

claims.documented_fact: Marvel-hosted biography attributes Connors abduction to Silvermane.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: Crowdsourced biography unverified; original issue and details pending.

claims.documented_fact: Marvel-hosted biography says Fisk controls the reanimated Silvermane with a painful collar.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: Precise issue and attribution require primary verification.

claims.documented_fact: Cloak attempts to kill Silvermane in the 1982 storyline.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: No assumption that this is their permanent attitude in all eras.

claims.documented_fact: Dagger attempts to kill Silvermane in the 1982 storyline.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: No assumption that this is her permanent attitude in all eras.

claims.documented_fact: The former partners reunite in 2018 to investigate a dangerous threat.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: Partnership is not proof of uninterrupted romance.

claims.documented_fact: Publisher says they must confront their true feelings and former relationship.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: The exact degree of reconciliation is not established by the synopsis.

claims.documented_fact: Masque overpowers Elektra during the Gang War.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: This is a specific confrontation, not an assumed lifelong feud.

claims.documented_fact: Richard plots to kill his father Wilson Fisk.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: The publisher identifies the father as abusive, but individual motives require panel review.

claims.documented_fact: Richard is Wilson Fisk son.
claims.interpretation_or_limitation: Family status does not establish affection or mutual loyalty.

warnings: Silvermane biography explicitly warns it is crowdsourced and unverified; Connors abduction and Fisk pain-collar assertions are provisional.
Janice and Randy planned a wedding in issue #31; do not infer it was completed.
Beetle Janice Lincoln is distinct from Abner Jenkins / MACH-1.
Madame Masque Whitney Frost is distinct from Morlock Masque.
Richard Fisk / Rose is distinct from Phillip Hayes and other people using the Rose identity.
Do not infer that Tombstone knows Peter Parker is Spider-Man from the #56 synopsis.
Cloak and Dagger have multiple romantic phases; 2018 issue summary does not prove permanent reunion.
All original panels and full canonical import-schema checks remain pending.
